profile.headline: Software Engineer at Capital One
profile.summary: I am patient and hardworking. I'm a very fast learner, and I have experience in a wide range of fields, from technology and science to art and music. I like setting goals for myself, and planning ahead. My objective is to be comfortable and happy while continuing to learn new things.

positions.title: Principal Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Android client side development (Kotlin)
• Developed and maintained high traffic features in the company’s flagship EASE app, allowing thousands of customers every day to manage their credit lines or refer friends to their credit card
• Provided guidance on refactoring the referrals feature to enable iOS/Android platform parity and cleaner code
• Added a dynamic toggle capability to the enterprise platform
• Managed the team’s UI test automation transformation
• Held office hours to assist team members, conducted interviews, and onboarded new hires

positions.title: Community Committee Co-Lead for the Women in Tech Chicago Chapter
positions.description:
• The Women in Tech organization at Capital One is a Business Resource Group (BRG) that aims to provide opportunities for networking and career growth for women technologists and allies.
• Organized numerous large scale events centered around Diversity, Inclusion, and Belonging
• Coordinated panels and keynote speakers, catering, activities, and budget
• Collaborated with other locations' chapters and other BRGs for intersectionality

positions.title: Senior Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Member of a full stack feature team, building end to end solutions across several microsystems responsible for credit card application decisioning (Java, Golang, Javascript, React, HTML, CSS, SQL)
• Quickly made emergency credit policy changes in response to the rapidly changing financial situation due to Covid
• Designed, built, and deployed an AWS Lambda in Golang to automate the generation of prequalified letters
• Supported and monitored our production systems on high traffic holidays and periodically  throughout the year
• Onboarded interns and new hires
• Instructed a coding introductory class to middle school students for our Coders program
• Directed a self defense workshop for our Women in Tech organization

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Took over development of a webapp that allowed users to easily build SQL queries with the intuitive UI (Java, Javascript, Angular, Spring Boot, HTML, CSS)
•	Translated thousands of lines of ETL files for our transaction data between different flavors of SQL (Teradata, Redshift, and Snowflake) to assist in our migration to the cloud
•	Amazon Web Services (AWS) Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (Nov. 2017)
•	Participated in recruitment efforts with LinkedIn, meet and greet events, and college career fairs - including being a speaker for a Diversity and Inclusion panel at UIUC
•	Member of a full stack feature team, building end to end solutions across several microsystems responsible for credit card application decisioning (Java, Golang, Javascript, React, HTML, CSS, SQL)
•	Developed on our front end credit card application site to add a Card Art Selector feature that allows our customers to choose their card’s appearance
•	Took charge of accessibility aspects of our features on the application site’s UI to make sure it was navigable by our customers with disabilities

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
•	Preventive Maintenance IoT Project
•	Collaborated with an Electrical Engineer to monitor the conditions of machinery in manufacturing plants
•	Modified a vb.net Windows Forms application to read in accelerometer sensor data from an OPC Server and then transfer the data to SQL Server
•	Converted the program into a Windows Service to run continuously
•	Developed with Xamarin.Android in C# to parse XML and display furniture products through a smart phone app

positions.title: Systems Analyst
positions.description:
•	Researched ADP Vantage functionality for company policy and company property applications
•	Created Excel templates to replace retired forms
•	Updated video training modules with new registration links

positions.title: IT App Developer
positions.description:
•	Converted reports from Oracle to SQL
•	Tested multiple reports and the updated company website
•	Produced Visual Studio LightSwitch applications to maintain data that was previously in Excel
•	Built an application to track products as they made their way along the factory assembly line, saving management hundreds of hours of time tracking down missing parts

positions.title: Piano Teacher
positions.description: Teaching primary level music and piano skills to young minds
